audit: NHL Phase 1A post-hoc scientific audit (documentation only)

phase1a_locked.holdout_2025: BURNED; not rerun, not rescored, no new 2025 calculation performed

findings.title: DISCRETE_INTERVAL_COVERAGE
findings.statement: The registered Phase 1A central intervals are deterministic inclusive integer equal-tail intervals [lo, hi] with lo = smallest k with F(k) >= (1-c)/2 and hi = smallest k with F(k) >= (1+c)/2. For a discrete PMF the model-implied probability mass of such an interval can be substantially larger than c because the boundaries contain point mass, so empirical_coverage - nominal is NOT by itself an absolute calibration error for NHL SOG count distributions.

report: empirical coverage minus mean attainable mass
randomized-PIT central coverage: mean of I[(1-c)/2 <= randomized_PIT <= (1+c)/2]
prospective_rule_phase1b_and_forward.scope: prospective metrics only; they do not reopen Phase 1A, change G4/H4, or change the 2024/2025 outcomes

findings.title: PROTOCOL_SERIALIZATION_NOTE
findings.statement: The committed phase1a_protocol.json serializes the expanding-fold train ranges as [2018,2020], [2018,2021], [2018,2022] (range-looking / ambiguous). The preregistered artifact is NOT edited and its hash is unchanged.

evidence.pre_result_code_file: nhl_sog_phase1a_run.py (FOLDS constant; committed before any development result)
evidence.dev_results_file: phase1a_dev_results.json reports the same executed train seasons
evidence.description: the executed folds are the expanding windows named in the task specification (D1 2018-2019 -> 2020 ... D4 2018-2022 -> 2023)

no_change_statement: No Phase 1A feature, model, hyper-parameter, gate or result is altered by this audit.
